description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the 'git am' command-line options, including scenarios such as retries, three-way merges, quiet mode, signoff, and rejection handling. It defines test setup steps, executes various 'git am' commands with different options, and checks the expected outcomes.

methods.name: format_patch
methods.description: Creates a patch file in email format from a specific commit, outputting to a file with the same name appended with '.eml'.
